intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for InMemoryHistoryEventPublisher. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Infrastructure adapter implementing HistoryEventPublisher with Sinks.many().replay().limit(properties.broadcastCapacity()) (bounded, drops oldest, never overflows or terminates). publish uses emitNext with Sinks.EmitFailureHandler.busyLooping(properties.emitRetryTimeout()). Owns the step log 'event broadcast downstream' (one logger call per published event). Registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration. Cover: subscriber receives events, bounded replay keeps only the last broadcastCapacity events, the claimed step log is captured via a Logback ListAppender as a structured event.
